inj.note: Tyson has logged consecutive limited practices since having his 21-day window to return from IR opened Wednesday. The rookie first-round pick could make his NFL regular-season debut as soon as Sunday against the Browns, though the Saints would probably want him to log at least one full practice before seeing game action, so it's more likely that Tyson's debut will be delayed at least one more week. His return to action would be proceeded by an official move adding Tyson to the 53-man roster.

news.h: Saints' Jordyn Tyson and Kelvin Banks Jr. return to practice
news.d: Report on Jordyn Tyson and Kelvin Banks Jr. returning to Saints practice following the bye week.

news.h: Saints' Jordyn Tyson returns to practice, listed as limited participant
news.d: New Orleans Saints rookie wide receiver Jordyn Tyson took a major step toward making his season debut Wednesday, returning to practice for the first time since injuring his right hamstring in a joint practice against the Jacksonville Jaguars on Aug. 13.
